senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) dye, color; dyed material. Sifra B’har, ch. I לצבוע בה צ׳ to use it for dyeing.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 6:5">Arakh. VI, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Arakhin 24a:20">24ᵃ</cite>) <he>צ׳ שצבעו לשמן</he> (not <he>שצבען</he>) dyed cloth which he had dyed for them (his wife and children).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:7">Num. R. s. 2</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>צְבָעִים</he>, <cite ref="R00066"><he>צְבָעִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:7">Ib.</cite> <he>וצבע מפה שלו דומה לי״ב צ׳</he> and the color of his (Benjamin’s) flag was like the twelve colors (combined); a. e.—V. <cite ref="R00159"><he>צוֹבַע</he></cite>.
